entries.en: Activate the defenses! Seal the station!
The arms aren't moving! Systems not responding!
Abandon the Citadel! Evacuate the Council!
Open the mass relays. The fleet needs reinforcements!
The relays are locked! Someone's taken over all the systems!
Citadel control! Citadel control! Do you copy?
We're getting hammered out here! Why won't you respond? Citadel control? Citadel control!
